title: Homocysteine-induced bone formation dysfunction reversed by icariin via the AKT/FOXO1 signaling pathway.
authors: Chao, Suzhen; Fu, Yunying; Peng, Xinyi; Zhou, Yili; Xia, Junjie; Chen, Ming; Li, Yang; Li, Shengyuan; Shi, Min; Xia, Xunli; Liu, Bo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究同型半胱氨酸致骨质疏松及淫羊藿苷经AKT/FOXO1通路的保护作用，属纯细胞/动物实验与信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Elevated homocysteine (Hcy) is an independent osteoporosis (OP) risk factor via oxidative stress-induced bone formation dysfunction. Icariin (ICA) has ethnopharmacological bone-protective effects, but its mechanism against Hcy-induced damage remains unclear. This study aimed to confirm Hcy's causal role in OP and clarify ICA's reversal effect via the AKT/FOXO1 pathway. Mendelian randomization (MR) analyzed Hcy-OP causality. In vitro, Hcy-treated MC3T3-E1 cells (osteoblast model) were evaluated via CCK-8, ALP/alizarin red staining, MDA/SOD detection, and Western blot. Network pharmacology/molecular docking predicted key targets; PI3K inhibitor LY294002 verified the AKT pathway. In vivo, dexamethasone-induced OP mice were assessed via micro-CT, ELISA, HE staining, and Western blot/qPCR. MR confirmed elevated Hcy as an upstream OP risk factor. Hcy inhibited osteoblast function, while ICA reversed this by enhancing proliferation/differentiation (elevated ALP, osteogenic markers: BMP2/COL1/OPG/RUNX2), reducing oxidative stress (lower MDA, higher SOD), and activating AKT/FOXO1 via phosphorylation. In OP mice, ICA improved BMD/trabecular microarchitecture, elevated P1NP, reduced CTX-1, and upregulated osteogenic pathway markers. Hcy-induced bone formation dysfunction drives OP progression. ICA alleviates oxidative stress and activates AKT/FOXO1 to protect against Hcy-related OP, offering a potential therapeutic strategy.
abstract_zh: 高同型半胱氨酸（Hcy）升高通过氧化应激诱导的骨形成功能障碍，是骨质疏松（OP）的独立危险因素。淫羊藿苷（ICA）具有民族药理学上的骨保护作用，但其对抗Hcy所致损伤的机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在确认Hcy在OP中的因果作用，并阐明ICA通过AKT/FOXO1通路的逆转效应。孟德尔随机化（MR）分析了Hcy与OP的因果关系。体外实验中，对Hcy处理的MC3T3-E1细胞（成骨细胞模型）通过CCK-8、ALP/茜素红染色、MDA/SOD检测和Western blot进行评估。网络药理学/分子对接预测了关键靶点；PI3K抑制剂LY294002验证了AKT通路。体内实验中，通过micro-CT、ELISA、HE染色和Western blot/qPCR评估地塞米松诱导的OP小鼠。MR证实了Hcy升高是OP的上游危险因素。Hcy抑制成骨细胞功能，而ICA通过增强增殖/分化（升高ALP、成骨标志物：BMP2/COL1/OPG/RUNX2）、减少氧化应激（降低MDA、升高SOD）以及通过磷酸化激活AKT/FOXO1来逆转此效应。在OP小鼠中，ICA改善了骨密度（BMD）/骨小梁微结构，升高P1NP，降低CTX-1，并上调成骨通路标志物。Hcy诱导的骨形成功能障碍驱动OP进展。ICA通过缓解氧化应激并激活AKT/FOXO1来对抗Hcy相关OP，提供了一种潜在的治疗策略。
